templates.uploadVerification: Each metadata-declared image is verified using the same flash-header settings. Separate image offsets preserve unmentioned erase sectors, including NVS; no merged FF padding or whole-chip erase is used.
templates.platformioIni:
; Firmware: ESP32 DevKit
[env:esp32]
platform = espressif32@8.0.0
board = esp32dev
framework = arduino
monitor_speed = 115200
build_flags = -fstack-usage
extra_scripts = post:tabstudio_esp_flash.py
